# Análisis de diseño experimental

## Base de datos

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dl27eSBCraeyFIgiZ5pQfPeA4GsxSwu9-BQW4Tnpkjo/edit?usp=sharing

## Identificar los factores

1. Factor A: Proporción de malta
- a1: 40:60
- a2: 60:40
2. Factor B: Temperatura de tostado
- b1: 100 °C
- b2: 110 °C
- b3: 120 °C
3. Factor C: Tiempo de tostado
- c1: 105 minutos
- c2: 115 minutos
- c3: 125 minutos

## Identificar el modelo

Diseño de Bloques Completos al Azar (DBCA) con arreglo factorial 2 × 2 × 2.

$$
Y = \mu + bloque + A + B + C + A*B + A*C + B*C + A*B*C + \xi
$$

# Activar los paquetes
```{r}

# Activar los paquetes

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(ggplot2)

gs4_deauth()

gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dl27eSBCraeyFIgiZ5pQfPeA4GsxSwu9-BQW4Tnpkjo/edit?usp=sharing" %>%
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read(
    ss = .,
    sheet = "fb",
    col_types = "c"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(rep, trat, prop, temp, tiempo,
        ),
      ~ as.factor(.x)
    ),
    across(
      c(brix, ph, densidad_g_cm3,
        grado_alcoholico_pct, acidez_total_pct),
      ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .x))
    )
  )

# Verificar los datos
str(fb)
summary(fb$brix)
head(fb$brix)


```

# Multivariate

```{r}
library(corrplot)
#| eval: false

library(factoextra)

dtx <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c("rep", "trat")) %>% 
  group_by(prop,
    temp,
    tiempo) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm =TRUE))) %>% 
  
  unite("rowname", c("prop", "temp", "tiempo"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  column_to_rownames() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T
      , graph = F
      , quali.sup = c(1, 2, 3))

var <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex=0.7)

var

cos <- mv %>% 
  fviz_pca_var(col.var = "cos2"
               , gradient.cols = c("red", "forestgreen", "blue")
               , repel = TRUE
               , labelsize = 2)

cos

ind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("ind")
           , cex = 0.7
           , label = "ind"
           , invisible = "quali"
           , col.hab = c("blue", "red")
           , habillage = 1
           )

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

cls <- mv %>% HCPC(nb.clust = -1, graph = FALSE)

map <- \() {plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)}

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust %>% 
  kable(caption = "Cluster membership of each individual")  
cls$desc.var$quanti %>% 
  kable(caption = "Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster")
cls$desc.var$category%>% 
  kable(caption = "Categorical variables significantly by cluster")  
table(cls$data.clust$clust) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Number of individuals assigned to each cluster")

plot <- list(var, cos, ind, map) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 

  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/multivariate.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 30)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```

## PCA information

```{r}
c1 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels = TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  # ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c1

c2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c2

c3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c3

lpanel <- c(c1, c2, c3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))
  
rpanel <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.9, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}

grid <- c(lpanel, rpanel) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/contribution.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 28, height = 36)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
